replies.body:
Hello,

Although you may feel cheated on by this ban, the reasons behind your ban can be taken the wrong way and can be really offensive to others, although it doesn't have any curse words the context is not something we're going to allow.
If you can change your name right now to something more appropriate which can't be mistaken, then you'll be appealed.
-Denied

Regards,
Auratix_,
